sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 220 x 170 x 51 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Sound Devices 833 user guide and product page read by a research pass 2026-11-12 (the store page answered 403): three XLR plus three TA3 mic/line inputs, two XLR main outputs (analog or AES3), two TA3 outputs, a 3.5 mm stereo output and aux input, 3.5 mm and 1/4 in headphone jacks (the guide versions differ), USB-C, USB-A host, TA4 DC input and L-series batteries. Headphone jack types differ between versions and one dealer lists a different input count, so beta-modelled: the ports are the Bêta proposal ports (9 of 22 listed). 220 x 170 x 51 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
